verdict.rationale: Agora documents its own CLI and RESTful APIs, which can drive features like creating a project and fetching usage numbers programmatically. Both are non-interactive interfaces suited to automation, but the evidence never describes headless operation or CI pipeline use. Missing for 10: documented headless/non-interactive CLI mode, CI integration guidance or examples, CLI auth for CI (tokens/env vars), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Connect the CLI, MCP server, and Skills to your AI workflow.
Agora also provides RESTful APIs that you use to implement features such as creating a project and fetching usage numbers programmatically.
